item.tib: spyi spungs gab pa gsung mchog thugs kyi brnag pa khro bo lha rgod thog pa'i sgrub gzhung
item.coloph: bon 'di ni gsas mkhar rin po che spyi spungs kyi nang nas/ gab pa gsung mchog dbal chen thugs kyi yang gzir khro bo lha rgod thog pa'i phrin las ces bya ba/ ston pa ye shes gtsug phud kyis/ lung don rgyud lung man ngag bcud du dril ba/ bsnyen sgrub las kyi go rim du bstan pa lags so/ gshen gsang ba 'dus ba'i (pa'i) thugs kyi brnag pa dbal bon stag la me 'bar gyi thugs bcud gsang ba sngags kyi rgyal po 'di la/ rgyas bsdus rnam pa gsum du gtan la dbab cing / rgyas pa lha bon yongs su dag pas don rgyud rgyas pa'i skor du gsungs te/ steng lha yul du gtan la dbab pa'o/ bsdus pa klu grub ye shes snying pos man ngag sgron me gsang ba thus pa'i skor du gsungs te/ 'og klu yul du gtan la phabs so/ 'bring po rgyal gshen mi lus bsam legs kyis lung don 'bring po sor bzhag gi skor du byung nas/ bar mi yul du gtan la dbab ste/ gshen nam mkha' snang ba mdog can la brgyud do/ de nas gdung rabs rim par brgyud nas/ bla chen dran pa nam mkha' la spel zhing bsgyar ro/ dus der nam mkha' stong pa la/ rlung gi 'khor los dbang bsgyur te/ g.yung drung bon gyi bstan pa 'char nub kyi skabs su/ gyer spungs dran pas srid pa'i rgyal mo la gnyer du gtad cing bcol lo/ de nas phyis kyi dus su sde brgyad 'dul ba'i dbal bon khro bo lha rgod thog pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i bu/ stag la'i thugs sras dbra khyung sngags 'chang dbal 'bar stag slag can la snyan du brgyud cing bstan pa mi nub dar zhing rgyas pa'i rgyu lags te/ phyi rabs sgrub brtson rjes 'jug rnams kyi spyod yul gsang ba yang dag gi bon lags so//
